title: Equal opportunity scholarship
summary: Scholarships supporting international students facing special circumstances and challenges during their degree program.

degree_levels.notes: Regular students working toward a degree (not exchange students). Degree level not explicitly restricted to specific types other than regular students.

institutions.notes: Must be enrolled at the University of Bonn.

nationality.notes: Foreign citizenship (dual nationals must not hold German citizenship). University entrance qualification from outside Germany.

residence.notes: Must be enrolled at the University of Bonn.

mandatory.text: Enrollment at the University of Bonn as regular students (not exchange students)
Foreign citizenship (dual nationals must not hold German citizenship)
University entrance qualification from outside Germany

Must meet at least one criterion: Refugee background, recognized disability level of at least 50% or chronic condition, caring for children under 18 in their own household, or caring for first- and second-degree relatives

exceptions.text: If you already receive financial support from the DAAD, further funding is not possible. If you receive funding from other public sources, only a top-up is possible.

required_documents.text: One- to two-page letter of motivation
Certificate of enrollment from the current semester (summer semester 2025)
Transcript of records (excerpt from the campus management platform BASIS)
Evidence of any special circumstances or challenges faced, including a disability or refugee background (official documents or certificates, birth certificate(s) for childcare)
Optional: Official letter of recommendation from teachers at the University of Bonn

steps.text: Upload requested documents as PDF files by the deadline

sources.title: Costs and Financing for International Students — University of Bonn
sources.notes: International degree-seeking students at the University of Bonn in Germany.
